definitions.explanation: A particular position or area. Can refer to physical locations or more abstract positions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{場所|ばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{静|しず}かな→静か：00755_shizuka⟧{場所|ばしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}したい→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to study in a quiet place.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{場所|ばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知|し}っています→知る：00458_shiru⟧。

examples.english: There's a good spot in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧{場所|ばしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}しています→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。⟦きれいな→きれい：00717_kirei⟧{場所|ばしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a place to take photos. A beautiful place would be nice.

notes:
{場所|ばしょ} means a specific place, location, or spot.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {場所|ばしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a place
- {場所|ばしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take up space
- {場所|ばしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a place
- 〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{場所|ばしょ}: a place to do ~
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{場所|ばしょ}: a good spot

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせ：07397_machiawase⟧{場所|ばしょ}: meeting place
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧{場所|ばしょ}: assembly point
- ⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧{場所|ばしょ}: parking spot

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧:
{場所|ばしょ} names a physical spot and stays concrete — a location you could point to on a map or in a room.
⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧ is far more versatile: besides "place" it means "aspect" or "point" (⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧, "his good points"), and it carries the grammar pattern 〜⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ that marks a stage of an action. {場所|ばしょ} can never be substituted into those uses.

OTHER USE:
In sumo, {場所|ばしょ} is the word for a tournament — the six annual tournaments are named by season and city, as in ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧{場所|ばしょ} (the summer tournament). Learners meet this mainly in sports reporting.
